items.title: Why Fair Isaac Corporation (FICO) Stock Is Trading Lower Today

The analyst firm pointed to competitive pressure from VantageScore as a growing concern. items.title: FICO Q2 Deep Dive: Mortgage Market Volatility and Platform Expansion Shape Outlook
items.summary: Credit scoring and analytics company FICO (NYSE:FICO) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 25.7% year on year to $674.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.53 billion at the midpoint came in 0.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $12.18 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: FICO Stock Drops the Most in 6 Years. Here’s What Went Wrong.
items.summary: FICO dropped on Thursday after the global analytics software company issued lower-than-expected guidance.  The company, formerly known as  Fair Isaac  closed down 17% at $1,139.54, snapping a four-day winning streak to post its largest percent decrease since March 16, 2020, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  For the third quarter of fiscal 2026, the company on Wednesday posted better-than-expected adjusted earnings of $12.18 a share versus consensus expectations for $11.76 a share.
